edges.reason: Constructor body is guarded by the initializer modifier.
initialize is protected by the initializer modifier.
initializer modifier reads and writes the _initialized flag.
initializer modifier reads and writes the _initializing flag.
isTopLevelCall local derives from and drives the initializer modifier flags.
_msgSender resolution inside initializer-driven initialization paths.
msg.sender becomes the owner through _setOwner during Ownable initialization.
_setOwner caches the previous owner into oldOwner.
previous owner value is emitted and compared against the _owner slot.
_setOwner writes the privileged _owner state variable.
onlyOwner on _authorizeUpgrade compares msg.sender against owner().
onlyOwner on transferOwnership gates on msg.sender.
onlyOwner on renounceOwnership gates on msg.sender.
newOwner parameter flows into privileged ownership state.
transferOwnership delegates the privileged write to _setOwner.
renounceOwnership delegates the privileged write to _setOwner.
_authorizeUpgrade reads owner() to authorize an upgrade.
newImplementation parameter is passed to the upgrade authorization hook.
upgradeTo calls _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade.
upgradeToAndCall calls _authorizeUpgrade before performing the upgrade.
newImplementation parameter flows into the privileged upgrade path.
upgradeTo delegates the upgrade to _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
upgradeToAndCall delegates the upgrade to _upgradeToAndCallSecure.
_upgradeToAndCallSecure caches the implementation into oldImplementation.
oldImplementation is compared with the EIP1967 implementation slot value.
_upgradeToAndCallSecure executes external code through _functionDelegateCall.
_functionDelegateCall performs an external delegatecall to attacker-influenced code.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads the caller allowance into currentAllowance.
currentAllowance - amount is written to _allowances inside an unchecked block.
transferFrom performs the balance movement through _transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in burnFrom.
burnFrom reduces the allowance via _approve.
burnFrom destroys tokens via _burn.
_transfer caches the sender balance into senderBalance.
senderBalance drives the unchecked write to _balances.
_transfer writes the sender and recipient balances.
recipient parameter is the target of the balance update.
amount parameter is subtracted from the sender balance.
unchecked subtraction operates on the cached senderBalance.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply.
_mint adds amount to the recipient balance in _balances.
_burn subtracts amount from _balances.
_burn subtracts amount from _totalSupply.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
initialize accepts the receiver parameter.
receiver is passed as the account of the initial _mint.
initialize mints the initial supply through _mint.
account parameter is credited by _mint.
amount parameter is added to balances and total supply in _mint.

normalization_plan.reason: receiver is only consumed as the account argument of the initial _mint call.
newImplementation exists solely as the argument of the upgrade authorization hook.
newImplementation is the argument of the public upgradeTo entry point.
newOwner is only used to drive the privileged ownership change.
account is the mint beneficiary parameter.
amount is the arithmetic input of the mint routine.
recipient is the transfer target parameter.
amount is the arithmetic input of the transfer routine.
isTopLevelCall is a temporary computed only inside the initializer modifier.
oldImplementation is a temporary used only for the UUPS rollback check.
oldOwner is a temporary used only to emit the OwnershipTransferred event.
senderBalance is a temporary holding the balance read before the unchecked write.
currentAllowance is a temporary holding the allowance before the unchecked deduction.
